n-k-k9-01.title: Headline claim pass survey evidence?
n-k-k9-01.goal: Compare headline with article survey numbers. Choose headline words wey go beyond evidence and write accurate headline.
n-k-k9-01.material:
Local news site publish this article.

[제목] 주민 대다수, 공원 야간 개방에 찬성

[본문] 구청이 지난 3일 공원 이용객 50명에게 설문한 결과, 야간 개방에 찬성한 사람은 28명이었다. 반대는 15명, 모르겠다는 응답은 7명이었다. 설문은 낮 시간에 공원 입구에서만 진행됐다. 구청은 "주민 전체의 의견으로 보기는 어렵다"며 추가 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.0: Check claim against evidence behind am.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.1: Notice quantity words 대다수, 과반 and group words 주민, 이용객.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.prompt: Compare headline with article numbers. Which headline words go beyond survey result? Choose all.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.0: Using body only, write who dem ask, where and when.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.1: Change 28 of 50 to percentage and see whether headline word fit.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.c: 28 people said they support, so figures back this word.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.d: Night opening na survey topic, so evidence support am.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.explain: Only daytime park entrance visitors were asked, so 주민 wider than evidence. 28 of 50 na 56%, just above half, no be 대다수. 찬성 and 야간 개방 match survey.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.0: Group claim really overreach (article itself say so). Check if 대다수 strong enough for 28 of 50.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.1: Strength word also overreach. Check who dem ask: visitors at one place and time only.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.0: For each headline, check group and number.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.1: Recalculate percentage for option wey use different one.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.a: This still says 주민, outside survey group, even though 과반 match percentage.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.c: 70% mix 28 supporters with 7 'not sure'; only 56% support am.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.d: 28 in favour and 15 against no be equal split, and 주민 still too broad.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.explain: 28 of 50 na 56%; people asked na park visitors. Headline name group and figure.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.prompt: Write ONE new Korean headline, single line, reporting survey without overclaim.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.0: Start with group asked, then number/share, then 찬성.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.1: Leave out word wey wider or stronger than calculation.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Reader fit know who answer survey?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My headline number fit calculate from article?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Any word make result sound stronger than 56% of 50 visitors?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Use 절반 넘게 instead of percentage.

n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c0: Use whole dates and whole hours.
n-k-k9-03.title: Who fit join coding camp?
n-k-k9-03.topic: Rules: 이상, 이하, 초과, 미만 (make several valid examples)
n-k-k9-03.goal: Read announcement boundaries, identify allowed numbers, make teams meeting every rule, report one in Korean.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.0: Read boundary words (이상, 이하, 초과, 미만) accurately.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.1: Find hidden result: fee sets team size.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.2: Make several valid solutions, check each.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.prompt: Which statements announcement allow? Choose all.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.0: Draw number line; show whether each endpoint included.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ask whether word includes number or means beyond it.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.a: A 14-year-old (만 14세) fit join team. Age number is 14.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.b: A 19-year-old (만 19세) fit join team. Age number is 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.b: 미만 excludes the number: under 19 no include 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.c: Team fee exactly 20,000 won is allowed.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.c: 초과 means more than, so it no include exactly 20,000. Number: 20.000.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.d: Team fee exactly 30,000 won is allowed.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.explain: 이상/이하 include number, 초과/미만 exclude. So 14 allowed, 19 no, 20,000 no, 30,000 yes.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.prompt: Make 3 different eligible teams. n=members, y=youngest age, o=oldest age (whole years).
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.0: Calculate fees for 3, 4, 5 members before selecting ages.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.1: Pick youngest age, then oldest within 3 years and below 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Oldest must be below 만 19세, so 19 not allowed.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Oldest age at least youngest age.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Oldest member no fit be younger than youngest.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Age gap no more than 3 years.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Fee over 20,000 and no more than 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Team fee (7,000 × members) must be over 20,000 and no more than 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.explain: Fee rule allow only 3 members (21,000 won) or 4 (28,000 won), though team rule allows up to 5. Ages from 14 to 18, gap max 3.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE team and write polite Korean registration message to organiser: member count, youngest/oldest ages, total fee.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Write members, ages, fee, ending each sentence politely.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Numbers in my message match one team I made?
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Total fee equal 7,000 won times member count?

n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only wetin you don read so far.
n-k-k9-04.goal: As context comes, notice sentence meaning flip between praise and irony, then politely reply to ironic comment.
n-k-k9-04.material: Monday morning, weekly team meeting. You enter room; 팀장님 says one sentence. Read each part, choose likely meaning and continue.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Update reading when new facts come.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.2: Respond to meaning, not just words.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: For each part, choose likely meaning of 팀장님 sentence before continue.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ask which time facts and speaker manner make words true or false.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wetin 팀장님 likely mean by sentence?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Without context, both readings possible: '참 ...도' fit show real admiration or ironic exaggeration. Words alone no settle it.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asking you come earlier next time.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Sentence no ask for future change; request would use -아 주세요 ending.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ending na statement (-네요), no be question about time.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Speaker say opposite of fact (early though you 40 minutes late), without smile: na irony. Learner translating words only go miss criticism.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Meeting don start 40 minutes, so nobody fit sincerely praise this arrival.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Speaker no ask anything; looking at clock show comment.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: With this new fact, wetin 팀장님 sentence mean?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Facts now match the words, so sentence literal perhaps warm. Context fit create irony and remove am too.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Still irony: criticism say you late.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Meeting at 10:30 and you arrive 50 minutes early, so no lateness to criticize.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Sincere comment: you really arrive early.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hint say you should leave room.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: No sign of that; coffee and smile show friendliness.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Question about when notice was posted.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Sentence no be question and no mention notice.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.reflect: Words no change; facts change. If sentence no match fact (here, 'early' for late person), listener understand irony (반어). New facts fit remove that meaning too.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Go back to second part: meeting start 9:00 and you arrive 9:40. Reply 팀장님 politely to real meaning of remark.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Start by naming wetin you do wrong in one short phrase.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.1: End with wetin you go do next time.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: My reply show say I understand remark as criticism?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: My reason or promise na something colleague fit accept?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I go talk this way to 팀장님 (polite, no defensive)?

n-k-k9-02.title: A connective wey turn argument direction
n-k-k9-02.topic: Connectives in argument (find and fix mistake)
n-k-k9-02.goal: Find line whose connective point wrong way. Choose one wey fix logic and rewrite line.
n-k-k9-02.material: Student wrote short paragraph about working from home for school magazine. One connective no match logic.
n-k-k9-02.thinking.0: Understand connectives signal addition, contrast, result.
n-k-k9-02.prereq.1: Can read short written style sentences (-다).
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.prompt: Choose line whose opening connective work against argument direction.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.0: Explain each line role in paragraph, then see how opening word connect to previous line.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.1: For each connective, ask whether sentence continue same direction or turn against it.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.explain: Line 3 moves from advantage (line 2) to problem, but connective adds same kind point. Need contrast word. Lines 4 and 5 correctly show result and conclusion.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.prompt: Which connective should replace line opening?
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.0: Say in English how this line relate to one before.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.1: Try each option; check whether both sentences still make sense together.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.a: This would say problem result from advantage, no sense.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.b: Problem no be an example of advantage in line 2.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.d: This would show problem as reason for advantage.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.explain: Paragraph go from advantage to drawback, so connective gats show contrast.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.prompt: Rewrite faulty line with correct connective, keeping rest. Add ONE sentence of your own starting with result word like 그래서 or 따라서, following from problem.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.0: Change only first word of wrong line.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.1: For new sentence, ask: because of this problem, what companies do or need?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: New connective show turn from advantage to problem?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Extra sentence really follow problem, no be advantage?

n-k-k9-05.title: Tell Grandma about bus fare.
n-k-k9-05.topic: Turn news into spoken Korean for grandma (rewrite for audience).
n-k-k9-05.goal: Rewrite news in polite spoken Korean for 68-year-old grandma. Keep what certain, what only planned, and what concerns her.
n-k-k9-05.material:
You read news on phone. Your grandma (68) live with you and take bus every day. She no read news.

[기사] 시는 다음 달 1일부터 시내버스 기본요금을 1,500원에서 1,700원으로 200원 인상할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 다만 만 65세 이상 어르신의 요금은 현행 1,500원으로 유지된다.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.0: Change speech style and word choice for new listener.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.1: Keep facts and status (planned, no happen yet) when retelling.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.2: Bring out wetin matter to this listener.
n-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Knows 존댓말 versus written news style.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: You go tell grandma by voice. Which retelling change the news meaning?
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Read article, list facts (when, how much, who pays what, how sure), then check each against every retelling.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Find retelling wey leave out or reverse one listed fact.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.a: Bus fare go increase 200 won next month, but no be for seniors.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.a: This keep plan, amount, and exception, so e faithful.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.b: Bus fare go increase 200 won next month for everybody.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.c: From next month seniors still pay 1,500 won; other people pay 200 won extra.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.c: This one faithful and mention seniors first.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.d: City say fare planned to increase by 200 won next month.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.d: Faithful: it says who report am and keeps it as plan.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.explain: Article say fare planned to rise next month, and people 65 and above keep old price. Distorted one say everybody pay more, so e remove exception wey matter to your grandma.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Which opening sentence fit when you dey talk with grandma?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Check endings: which one fit news desk and which one fit family talk?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Check whether verb na everyday word or newspaper word.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.b: This still sound like news announcement, too stiff for family talk.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.c: Plain casual ending no show respect to grandma, and -니까 sound impatient.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.d: '인상되오니 … 바랍니다' na notice language, and e present planned increase like final decision.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.explain: Family speech to elder polite but soft (-요), uses everyday verb (오르다 instead of 인상되다), and -대요 report wetin another person talk.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.prompt: Now tell grandma in your own Korean: no more than 2 sentences, polite -요, no news endings. Keep date, amount, say na plan, and what apply to her.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.0: First sentence: when, how much, and say na plan. Second: wetin e mean for her.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.1: Change every news word to word wey you go use for dinner table.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My version still say increase only planned?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Grandma go know say she herself still pay same fare?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na words wey I go really use for house?
